epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of telemetry materials rendered originate from live backend data
requirements: R1: The TelemetryContactTerminalView must fetch from the search endpoint and display real records instead of hardcoded mock data.
R2: The component must explicitly render the four standard data states: empty, loading, error, and present.

slices.title: Patch TelemetryContactTerminalView for server state synchronization
slices.jtbd: When repairing this defect for this epic, I want to wire the existing component directly to its backend endpoint and remove the static records, so that the UI reflects the true server state.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the view mounts, When the data request is pending, Then a loading state is displayed.
Given the search endpoint returns zero rows, When the request completes, Then a distinct empty state is shown and no static mock records are rendered.
Given the backend returns an error or is stopped, When the request fails, Then a clear error message is presented to the user.
Given the endpoint returns documents, When the request completes, Then the actual documents are listed with titles, authors, dates, and download buttons.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero instances of static mock records rendered
